title: HOXA9-3D-genome-analysis
description:
Analysis code developed by Fan Feng for the Hi-C and 3D genome analyses accompanying the manuscript cited below. Includes Hi-C processing, A/B compartment analysis, TopDom TAD calling, chromatin loop analysis, aggregate peak analysis, and insulation analysis.

Associated manuscript: Wang, X. Q. D.*, Yang, W.*, Feng, F.*, Shum, M., Bell, O., Liu, J., Zhang, X., & Dou, Y. (2026). HOXA9 reinforces chromatin boundary insulation to maintain leukemia associated genome architecture. Science Advances, accepted; publication pending. *These authors contributed equally (co-first authors).

Input datasets are not included; accessions and data links are documented in the repository README. Coordinates use hg19 / GRCh37. Scripts retain original execution paths that must be adapted to the local computing environment. Downstream classification of TADs as unchanged, fused, split, or shifted is not included. Third-party software retains its respective licenses.
